name: Wrong Echo
description: Take a light wrong on the guard and send a faint echo of it back.

name: Rebound Spark
description: Snap back a spark that carries the shape of the blow just taken.

name: Stung Step
description: Step out of a blow and in again on the rebound while the striker is still extended.

name: Wrong Mirror
description: Hold a mirror of qi before the body that sends back every blow in the shape it came.

name: Retort Strike
description: Answer a blow with a strike to the same place at the same weight.

name: Grievance Wave
description: Release the stored sting of many blows in one wave that strikes all near.

name: Rebounding Wrong
description: Hold the field open to every wrong and throw them all back on those who did them.

name: Wrath Return
description: Catch a furious blow and give back its fury in a single hard strike.

name: Wrong Undone
description: Return the whole of a great blow to its sender in exact measure and past their guard.

name: Deed Scale
description: Hold out an unseen scale and feel which way a person's deeds tip it.

name: Weight Spark
description: Throw a spark heavy with the foe's own guilt so it lands harder than it looks.

name: Judge Stance
description: Stand square in the stance of a judge behind a guard that gives way to no pressure.

name: Heavy Deed
description: Drop the weight of a foe's heaviest deed onto their shoulders.

name: Balance Probe
description: Probe a foe's balance of good and ill to find where it tips most.

name: Verdict Beam
description: Fire a beam whose force is set by the sum of the foe's worst deeds.

name: Weighed Wave
description: Send a wave over the field that strikes each foe by the weight of their own deeds.

name: Guilt Press
description: Press the guilt of the foe's deeds into their qi until every move drags.

name: Weighed Judgment
description: Weigh the foe's deeds and strike with that exact weight where no guard can lessen it.

name: Lien Spark
description: Throw a spark that leaves a small lien on the foe's qi where it lands.

name: Collector Guard
description: Hold a short guard that keeps the debtor at arm's length.

name: Claim Step
description: Step to cut off the debtor's way and stand where their retreat must pass.

name: Claim Chain
description: Cast a chain of claim about the debtor's wrists that cannot be struck through.

name: Seizure Strike
description: Strike to seize a part of the debtor's qi in payment of what they owe.

name: Writ Mark
description: Set a writ of claim on the debtor so that every ally's blows land the surer.

name: Foreclose
description: Foreclose on the debtor's best technique and seal it until the debt is cleared.

name: Debt Cage
description: Raise a cage of owed harm round the debtor whose bars grow with every wrong they have done.

name: Total Seizure
description: Seize the debtor's whole stock of qi and technique into a lien and hold it in the user's hand.

name: Equal Ray
description: Loose a ray of exactly the strength of the last ray taken.

name: Equal Guard
description: Meet a blow with a guard of exactly its weight and no more.

name: Measure Step
description: Step the same distance the foe stepped and stand at the same range.

name: Equal Return
description: Return a blow at the same place and weight in the same breath it landed.

name: Mirror Wound
description: Open on the foe the very wound they opened on the user and no deeper.

name: Even Pang
description: Let the foe feel the pang they caused and lose the rhythm of their next move.

name: Matched Fury
description: Match the fury of the foe's assault blow for blow in a flurry that is exact to the last strike.

name: Echoed Harm
description: Echo all the harm done to the user and allies back over those who did it.

name: Perfect Requital
description: Give back all that was done in perfect measure so that no guard or hide can lessen it.

name: Account Glance
description: Glance at a foe and know at once what they still owe and how long it has been due.

name: Slow Sting
description: Send a bead that lands a heartbeat late and stings twice.

name: Hushed Guard
description: Turn a blow quietly aside and keep its weight to be repaid later.

name: Delayed Blow
description: Plant a blow that lands moments after the strike that bears it.

name: Interest Mark
description: Mark the foe with a debt that grows with each breath they leave it unpaid.

name: Late Return
description: Store a blow's force and return it after the foe has relaxed.

name: Compounded Harm
description: Hold a harm back and let it compound until it pierces on release.

name: Long Debt
description: Bind the foe to a debt so old that it has grown heavy enough to hold them still.

name: Unpaid Account
description: Collect an unpaid harm all at once when the foe is weakest through any guard.

name: Wheel Pivot
description: Turn a half circle on the heel and let the wheel carry the body past a blow.

name: Good Seed
description: Sow a seed of good will in an ally so that it ripens into steadier strength.

name: Fruit Glow
description: Let the fruit of a past kindness warm an ally's wound and ease it.

name: Fruit Share
description: Share the fruit of the user's merit among the allies near and strengthen and mend each.

name: Wheel Press
description: Press down on a foe with the wheel's weight until the harm they sowed comes up.

name: Reaping Cut
description: Reap the harm a foe has sown with a single cut across their guard.

name: Reaping Wheel
description: Spin the wheel through the field and reap every foe by the harm they have sown.

name: Wheel Boon
description: Turn the wheel to its bright side and bless all allies with strength and healing.

name: Turning Wheel
description: Turn the great wheel so that harm falls on the foes in the field and good lifts every ally.
